Title: Define SCADA interface requirements before procurement
Root Cause: Requirements not frozen at contract award
What Happened: Supplier delivered protocol that did not match grid code.
Lesson Learned: Freeze SCADA interface spec before RFP.
Recommendation: Include interface freeze milestone in project plan.

Title: Vehicle collision to an exposed trunk cable
Root Cause: The cable was exposed, and not protected by the pile o other method
What Happened: A vehicle collisioned with a trunk cable pile causing a shortcircuit
Lesson Learned: All aerial cable should be at min distance from road or physically protected.
Recommendation: Update the tech spec to include the protection requirements and define the min distance from roads that trunk cable shall be install. Also try to avoid installing trunk cable in both side of the pile when a road is nearby.
